name: 13724-multiimage-qwen3vl32b-tp4
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, no quantization_config; 63 GB of safetensors, ~15.8 GB of weights per rank at TP4.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, 10% warmup and 10% cooldown, bounded at 600 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm, ONE turn: four 1280x720 JPEGs plus 200 tokens of text in, 16 tokens out, ignore_eos, temperature 0.0.
purpose: A 32-billion-parameter listing assistant giving brief answers about four uploaded photos, four concurrent users, four GPUs.
launch:
# Launch line: four GPUs of one node, TP4, over the OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint.
# Nothing here is tuned.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct
tp-size: 4
trust-remote-code: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
disable-radix-cache: true

# fa3 needs SM90 and `sgl_kernel.flash_attn` importable in this venv; both hold here.
attention-backend: flashinfer
mm-attention-backend: fa3
mm-enable-dp-encoder: true
random-seed: 42
